## The problem

What are you trying to do, and what gets in the way today?

## Proposed change

What would you like to see? If it touches a file a user owns (`registry/**`, `registry.config.json`, `README.md` notes) or a template-owned path (`apps/docs/**`, `packages/**`), say which.

## Alternatives you considered

## Fit

This repo stays docs-only: a static export with no auth, no database and no required environment variables. Features that need a server belong to the hosted version (https://platform.behivetech.com/expanded). If you are unsure which side your idea falls on, say so and we will work it out here.

## Anything else

Links, sketches, examples from other tools.
